say:0:1220902001:0.text: That older man seems to be blind. Does he need help?
say:0:1220902001:0.source_cn: 那位大叔似乎是盲人，他遇到什么困难了吗？
say:0:1220902001:0.male: That older man seems to be blind. Does he need help?
say:0:1220902001:0.female: That older man seems to be blind. Does he need help?

say:3:1220903001:0.text: Sir, what happened to your eyes? Do you need help?
say:3:1220903001:0.source_cn: 这位大叔，你的眼睛怎么了？需要帮忙吗？

say:4:1220903002:1.text: My eyes? I was injured in a carriage accident last year. I haven't been able to see since then...
say:4:1220903002:1.source_cn: 眼睛？去年旅行时马车出了事故，我受了伤，后来就看不见了……

say:5:1220903003:0.text: But forget my eyes, I can't find my coin purse! It's not in my pockets, and I've searched all over the ground...
say:5:1220903003:0.source_cn: 但现在重要的不是眼睛，是钱袋！我的钱袋不见了，身上没有...

say:6:1220903004:0.text: Chippy doesn't see it anywhere nearby... Oh no, someone must have swiped it!
say:6:1220903004:0.source_cn: 附近也没有呢……糟糕，肯定是被人偷走了！

say:7:1220903005:1.text: I have such rotten luck! Everything was going smoothly on my boat trip home, but suddenly the waves surged and we capsized.
say:7:1220903005:1.source_cn: 我真是太倒霉了！这次搭船回家，本来一切顺利，可突然海浪...

say:8:1220903006:1.text: I was lucky; a sailor pulled me onto a lifeboat, and I made it to Rustport safely. My guide wasn't so fortunate, however...
say:8:1220903006:1.source_cn: 算我命大，被水手拉上了救生艇，活着到了锈锚港。可我的向...

say:9:1220903007:0.text: Ah, it seems you only came here by accident, just like us.
say:9:1220903007:0.source_cn: 原来大叔是因为乘坐的海船出了事故，才来到这里的。

say:10:1220903008:1.text: I'm aware that Rustport is controlled by gangs. I wanted to leave, but the port has been shut down, and there are no ships available...
say:10:1220903008:1.source_cn: 是啊，我也知道锈锚港是黑帮的地盘，本想搭艘船离开的，谁...

say:11:1220903009:1.text: Now I can't leave, and I can't stay and explore without my money pouch or a guide... How did I ever end up like this?
say:11:1220903009:1.source_cn: 现在可好，想走走不了，想留下游览，丢了钱袋又没有向导…...

say:12:1220903010:0.text: Oh, come on now! Things could be far worse! And anyway, we'll help you!
say:12:1220903010:0.source_cn: 呃，“沦落”，也没有那么夸张吧……大叔，别担心，我们会...

say:13:1220903011:1.text: Dura above, losing something around here means it's likely gone for good...
say:13:1220903011:1.source_cn: 唉，艾雅在上，在这儿丢了东西，或许就再也找不到了……

choice_prompt:14:1220903011.text: Dura above, losing something around here means it's likely gone for good...
choice_prompt:14:1220903011.source_cn: 唉，艾雅在上，在这儿丢了东西，或许就再也找不到了……

say:15:1220903012:1.text: Of course not. Even blind, you'd know if someone fiddled with your money, wouldn't you?
say:15:1220903012:1.source_cn: 当然没有。别说是我一个盲人，就是你们也不会随便让人动自...
say:15:1220903012:1.male: Of course not. Even blind, you'd know if someone fiddled with your money, wouldn't you?
say:15:1220903012:1.female: Of course not. Even blind, you'd know if someone fiddled with your money, wouldn't you?

say:16:1220903013:1.text: I always keep it in my inner pocket and never let anyone touch it.
say:16:1220903013:1.source_cn: 我一直把它塞在衣服内袋里，从来没让人碰过。
say:16:1220903013:1.male: I always keep it in my inner pocket and never let anyone touch it.
say:16:1220903013:1.female: I always keep it in my inner pocket and never let anyone touch it.

say:17:1220903016:0.source_cn: 那么，有什么可疑人物接近过你吗？

say:18:1220903017:1.text: In case you've forgotten, I'm blind. It's hard for me to tell... Dura above, who would steal from a blind man?
say:18:1220903017:1.source_cn: 我看不见，不知道什么人算可疑。艾雅啊，谁忍心偷我一个盲...
say:18:1220903017:1.male: In case you've forgotten, I'm blind. It's hard for me to tell... Dura above, who would steal from a blind man?
say:18:1220903017:1.female: In case you've forgotten, I'm blind. It's hard for me to tell... Dura above, who would steal from a blind man?

choice_prompt:19:1220903017.text: In case you've forgotten, I'm blind. It's hard for me to tell... Dura above, who would steal from a blind man?
choice_prompt:19:1220903017.source_cn: 我看不见，不知道什么人算可疑。艾雅啊，谁忍心偷我一个盲人的钱呢？
choice_prompt:19:1220903017.male: In case you've forgotten, I'm blind. It's hard for me to tell... Dura above, who would steal from a blind man?
choice_prompt:19:1220903017.female: In case you've forgotten, I'm blind. It's hard for me to tell... Dura above, who would steal from a blind man?

say:20:1220903018:1.text: A few merchants approached to peddle their goods, but they left after I declined.
say:20:1220903018:1.source_cn: 倒是有些招揽生意的商贩围过来，不过被我拒绝后就走了。
say:20:1220903018:1.male: A few merchants approached to peddle their goods, but they left after I declined.
say:20:1220903018:1.female: A few merchants approached to peddle their goods, but they left after I declined.

say:21:1220903019:1.text: Wait, I remember now! There was a group of children...
say:21:1220903019:1.source_cn: 啊，我想起来了！有一群小孩子……
say:21:1220903019:1.male: Wait, I remember now! There was a group of children...
say:21:1220903019:1.female: Wait, I remember now! There was a group of children...

say:23:1220903023:1.text: Yes, a few kids came up to me and asked if I wanted my boots cleaned, but I declined.
say:23:1220903023:1.source_cn: 对，是有几个小孩子聚上来，问我要不要擦靴子，我拒绝了。

say:24:1220903024:0.text: They clustered around me, tugging at my coat and sleeves, pleading for a while before they left...
say:24:1220903024:0.source_cn: 他们围在我身边，扯着我的衣角和袖口求恳了一阵子才离开……
say:24:1220903024:0.male: They clustered around me, tugging at my coat and sleeves, pleading for a while before they left...
say:24:1220903024:0.female: They clustered around me, tugging at my coat and sleeves, pleading for a while before they left...

choice_prompt:25:1220903024.text: They clustered around me, tugging at my coat and sleeves, pleading for a while before they left...
choice_prompt:25:1220903024.source_cn: 他们围在我身边，扯着我的衣角和袖口求肯了一阵子才离开……
choice_prompt:25:1220903024.male: They clustered around me, tugging at my coat and sleeves, pleading for a while before they left...
choice_prompt:25:1220903024.female: They clustered around me, tugging at my coat and sleeves, pleading for a while before they left...

say:26:1220903025:0.text: By the voices, I think there were two or three... both boys and girls.
say:26:1220903025:0.source_cn: 听声音，大概有两三个吧……男女都有。
say:26:1220903025:0.male: By the voices, I think there were two or three... both boys and girls.
say:26:1220903025:0.female: By the voices, I think there were two or three... both boys and girls.

say:27:1220903026:0.text: I've heard many of the homeless children here moonlight as thieves...
say:27:1220903026:0.source_cn: 小孩子呀……我听说这里不少流浪儿都会“兼职”窃贼……
say:27:1220903026:0.male: I've heard many of the homeless children here moonlight as thieves...
say:27:1220903026:0.female: I've heard many of the homeless children here moonlight as thieves...

say:28:1220903027:0.text: This is the clue we needed! To assist the blind traveler who lost his pouch, the mighty Sir Chippy and his companions shall set off at once!
say:28:1220903027:0.source_cn: 这就是调查切入点了！为了帮助丢失钱袋的盲人旅行者——仓...
say:28:1220903027:0.male: This is the clue we needed! To assist the blind traveler who lost his pouch, the mighty Sir Chippy and his companions shall set off at once!
say:28:1220903027:0.female: This is the clue we needed! To assist the blind traveler who lost his pouch, the mighty Sir Chippy and his companions shall set off at once!

choice:25:0:1.text: How many of them were there?
choice:25:0:1.male: How many of them were there?
choice:25:0:1.female: How many of them were there?

choice:19:0:1.text: Anyone gotten too close to you?
choice:19:0:1.male: Anyone gotten too close to you?
choice:19:0:1.female: Anyone gotten too close to you?

say:30:1220903020:1.text: Except for a porter and a few vendors, I've only spoken to you.
say:30:1220903020:1.source_cn: 除了帮我拎行李的杂工和一些商贩，就只有你们主动跟我说过话。
say:30:1220903020:1.male: Except for a porter and a few vendors, I've only spoken to you.
say:30:1220903020:1.female: Except for a porter and a few vendors, I've only spoken to you.

choice:19:1:2.text: Did anyone stop to chat with you?
choice:19:1:2.male: Did anyone stop to chat with you?
choice:19:1:2.female: Did anyone stop to chat with you?

say:32:1220903014:1.text: My money pouch is always tucked in my inner pocket! With Dura as my witness, I never let anyone touch it!
say:32:1220903014:1.source_cn: 塞在衣服内袋里，艾雅作证，我都没让别人碰过它！
say:32:1220903014:1.male: My money pouch is always tucked in my inner pocket! With Dura as my witness, I never let anyone touch it!
say:32:1220903014:1.female: My money pouch is always tucked in my inner pocket! With Dura as my witness, I never let anyone touch it!

say:33:1220903015:1.text: I was going to hire a carriage to the inn when I discovered a tear in my pocket, and the money pouch had disappeared...
say:33:1220903015:1.source_cn: 我正打算雇辆马车去旅馆，就发现衣服内袋破了口子，钱袋不...
say:33:1220903015:1.male: I was going to hire a carriage to the inn when I discovered a tear in my pocket, and the money pouch had disappeared...
say:33:1220903015:1.female: I was going to hire a carriage to the inn when I discovered a tear in my pocket, and the money pouch had disappeared...

choice:14:1:2.text: Do you keep it in a safe place?
choice:14:1:2.male: Do you keep it in a safe place?
choice:14:1:2.female: Do you keep it in a safe place?

say:2:1220904001:0.text: Excuse me... do you know where the shoe shiner kids are?
say:2:1220904001:0.source_cn: 请问……你知道那些小孩子，就是经常给人擦鞋的那些，他们...

say:3:1220904002:0.text: Hm? Aren't you a kid too? You seem even younger than them...
say:3:1220904002:0.source_cn: 嗯？你不也是个小孩子吗？感觉你还没他们年纪大……

say:4:1220904003:0.text: Chippy is not a kid! Chippy is a familiar! Oh, forget it...
say:4:1220904003:0.source_cn: 满满才不是小孩子！满满是使魔！唉，算了……

say:5:1220904004:1.text: Yeesh, when did kids get so sensitive?
say:5:1220904004:1.source_cn: 哎呀，小孩子怎么那么大脾气。

say:6:1220904005:1.text: I've seen the ones you're asking about, but they're all vagrants, running around all over the place at random.
say:6:1220904005:1.source_cn: 你问的那几个人我倒是见过，但他们都是流浪儿，到处乱跑，...

say:7:1220904006:1.text: I remember seeing them on the <style="highlight">street west of the market</style>, why don't you check there?
say:7:1220904006:1.source_cn: 我记得在<style=highlight>市场西边的街...

say:2:1220905001:0.text: Sir, do you know the kids who shine shoes around here?
say:2:1220905001:0.source_cn: 先生，你认识在这里给人擦鞋的那几个孩子吗？

say:3:1220905002:0.text: The kids who shine shoes... are you talking about Feodor and his crew?
say:3:1220905002:0.source_cn: 擦鞋的孩子……是费曼他们吧？

say:4:1220905003:1.text: You know them! Can you tell me where they stay?
say:4:1220905003:1.source_cn: 哇，你认识他们！他们住在哪里呢？

say:5:1220905004:1.text: I wouldn't say I know them, but I see them often on my way back and sometimes say hello.
say:5:1220905004:1.source_cn: 算不上认识，我回家路上总能看到他们，偶尔也打个招呼。

say:6:1220905005:0.text: Oh, right <style="highlight">over the bridge to the west</style>.

say:0:1220906001:0.text: Come on, let's hurry and find those kids!
say:0:1220906001:0.source_cn: 走吧走吧，咱们快去找那几个小孩子！
say:0:1220906001:0.male: Come on, let's hurry and find those kids!
say:0:1220906001:0.female: Come on, let's hurry and find those kids!

say:1:1220906002:0.text: Chippy is as energetic as ever.
say:1:1220906002:0.source_cn: 满满还是这么有干劲啊。
say:1:1220906002:0.male: Chippy is as energetic as ever.
say:1:1220906002:0.female: Chippy is as energetic as ever.

say:1:1220907002:0.text: Speak to the oldest one, he's probably the leader.
say:1:1220907002:0.source_cn: 找那个年纪最大的聊聊，他应该是头领。
say:1:1220907002:0.male: Speak to the oldest one, he's probably the leader.
say:1:1220907002:0.female: Speak to the oldest one, he's probably the leader.

say:1:1220908001:0.text: Would you like a shoe shine? Just look at all the mud on your boots.
say:1:1220908001:0.source_cn: 尊贵的客人是要擦鞋吗？看看，您靴子上都沾满泥了。
say:1:1220908001:0.male: Would you like a shoe shine? Just look at all the mud on your boots.
say:1:1220908001:0.female: Would you like a shoe shine? Just look at all the mud on your boots.

say:2:1220908002:0.text: I'm Feodor, the famous shoe shiner in Rustport. Don't be fooled by my age, my skills are top-notch! Just ten minutes, and you'll see your own reflection in your boots!
say:2:1220908002:0.source_cn: 咱可是锈锚港有名的“擦鞋匠”费曼，别看咱年纪小，手艺绝...
say:2:1220908002:0.male: I'm Feodor, the famous shoe shiner in Rustport. Don't be fooled by my age, my skills are top-notch! Just ten minutes, and you'll see your own reflection in your boots!
say:2:1220908002:0.female: I'm Feodor, the famous shoe shiner in Rustport. Don't be fooled by my age, my skills are top-notch! Just ten minutes, and you'll see your own reflection in your boots!

say:3:1220908003:0.text: Sofio, Hales—we've got customers, come lend a hand!
say:3:1220908003:0.source_cn: 索菲、海尔斯——来客人了，快过来搭把手！

say:7:1220908004:0.text: Honored guest, come, have a seat! Let me help you take off your boots!
say:7:1220908004:0.source_cn: 尊贵的客人，快请坐，请坐！我来帮您脱下靴子吧！
say:7:1220908004:0.male: Honored guest, come, have a seat! Let me help you take off your boots!
say:7:1220908004:0.female: Honored guest, come, have a seat! Let me help you take off your boots!

say:8:1220908005:1.text: Your coat is dusty, let's take it off and I'll clean it for you!
say:8:1220908005:1.source_cn: 客人，您的外套沾了灰，请脱下来，我帮您掸干净！
say:8:1220908005:1.male: Your coat is dusty, let's take it off and I'll clean it for you!
say:8:1220908005:1.female: Your coat is dusty, let's take it off and I'll clean it for you!

say:13:1220908006:0.text: No, no, we're not here for a shine... Hey, why are you reaching into Chippy's bag?
say:13:1220908006:0.source_cn: 不对不对，我们不是来擦鞋的……咦，你的手怎么往满满的背...

say:14:1220908007:1.text: Ah! Don't touch my bag, it's filled with dangerous magical components!
say:14:1220908007:1.source_cn: 呀！不要摸我的小包，里面都是危险的施法材料！

choice_prompt:15:1220908007.text: Ah! Don't touch my bag, it's filled with dangerous magical components!
choice_prompt:15:1220908007.source_cn: 呀！不要摸我的小包，里面都是危险的施法材料！

choice:15:0:1.text: Trying a little sleight of hand?
choice:15:0:1.male: Trying a little sleight of hand?
choice:15:0:1.female: Trying a little sleight of hand?

say:0:1220910001:0.text: Oh no, those kids got away!
say:0:1220910001:0.source_cn: 哎呀，让那群小孩子跑掉了！
say:0:1220910001:0.male: Oh no, those kids got away!
say:0:1220910001:0.female: Oh no, those kids got away!

say:1:1220910002:0.text: Fear not, Chippy is a skilled tracker, we'll find them in no time!
say:1:1220910002:0.source_cn: 别担心，满满可擅长找人了，一定能找到他们的！
say:1:1220910002:0.male: Fear not, Chippy is a skilled tracker, we'll find them in no time!
say:1:1220910002:0.female: Fear not, Chippy is a skilled tracker, we'll find them in no time!

say:0:1220911001:0.text: There he is, that's the one!
say:0:1220911001:0.male: There he is, that's the one!
say:0:1220911001:0.female: There he is, that's the one!

say:1:1220911002:0.text: You're not getting away this time!
say:1:1220911002:0.source_cn: 这次可不会让你再跑掉了！

say:3:1220912001:0.text: You're the ones who robbed that blind man on the pier, aren't you?
say:3:1220912001:0.source_cn: 你们……就是你们在码头偷了那位盲人大叔的钱袋吧？
say:3:1220912001:0.male: You're the ones who robbed that blind man on the pier, aren't you?
say:3:1220912001:0.female: You're the ones who robbed that blind man on the pier, aren't you?

say:4:1220912002:1.text: It's wrong to steal! Can't you just stick to shoe shining? Why rob people?
say:4:1220912002:1.source_cn: 偷窃是不对的，你们不是也在做正经的工作吗？为什么还要偷东西？
say:4:1220912002:1.male: It's wrong to steal! Can't you just stick to shoe shining? Why rob people?
say:4:1220912002:1.female: It's wrong to steal! Can't you just stick to shoe shining? Why rob people?

say:5:1220912003:1.text: Butt out! You guys know nothing, you uh... foreign mice! This is how we get by in Rustport!
say:5:1220912003:1.source_cn: 多管闲事！你们这些啥都不懂的外乡人，呃，外乡耗子！咱们...
say:5:1220912003:1.male: Butt out! You guys know nothing, you uh... foreign mice! This is how we get by in Rustport!
say:5:1220912003:1.female: Butt out! You guys know nothing, you uh... foreign mice! This is how we get by in Rustport!

say:7:1220912005:1.text: Will manners earn us any more copper coins? We street kids can't get enough to eat, can't afford medicine... So what good is being polite?
say:7:1220912005:1.source_cn: 礼貌能让咱多赚几个铜板吗？咱们流浪儿吃也吃不饱，生病也...

choice_prompt:8:1220912005.text: Will manners earn us any more copper coins? We street kids can't get enough to eat, can't afford medicine... So what good is being polite?
choice_prompt:8:1220912005.source_cn: 礼貌能让咱多赚几个铜板吗？咱们流浪儿吃也吃不饱，生病也没钱治，还要什么礼貌？

say:10:1220912006:0.text: What's the point in asking? You caught me, I give up! If it's just the blind man's money pouch, I'll return it!
say:10:1220912006:0.source_cn: 有什么好问的，被你们逮着了，我认栽！不就是那个盲大叔的...
say:10:1220912006:0.male: What's the point in asking? You caught me, I give up! If it's just the blind man's money pouch, I'll return it!
say:10:1220912006:0.female: What's the point in asking? You caught me, I give up! If it's just the blind man's money pouch, I'll return it!

say:12:1220912007:0.text: Feodor, we can't hand it over! Think of little Jack...
say:12:1220912007:0.source_cn: 费曼大哥，不能给他们！小杰克他们的病……

say:13:1220912008:1.text: Forget it, we'll find another way to make money...
say:13:1220912008:1.source_cn: 算了，咱们再去想办法搞钱就是……

choice_prompt:14:1220912008.text: Forget it, we'll find another way to make money...
choice_prompt:14:1220912008.source_cn: 算了，咱们再去想办法搞钱就是……

say:15:1220912009:1.text: Well... it was pouring down rain a few days ago and we slept on the streets. Without enough warm clothes, a few of us got pretty sick.
say:15:1220912009:1.source_cn: 嗯，前几天下暴雨，我们露宿街头，又没有足够的衣服，好几...
say:15:1220912009:1.male: Well... it was pouring down rain a few days ago and we slept on the streets. Without enough warm clothes, a few of us got pretty sick.
say:15:1220912009:1.female: Well... it was pouring down rain a few days ago and we slept on the streets. Without enough warm clothes, a few of us got pretty sick.

say:16:1220912010:0.text: They were all burning with fever and couldn't even get up, even if they wanted a drink of water...
say:16:1220912010:0.source_cn: 他们都烧糊涂了，叫也叫不醒，连水都喝不下……
say:16:1220912010:0.male: They were all burning with fever and couldn't even get up, even if they wanted a drink of water...
say:16:1220912010:0.female: They were all burning with fever and couldn't even get up, even if they wanted a drink of water...

say:18:1220912013:0.text: That's enough. Don't bother explaining anything to them. Look at their clothes... They've never starved in their lives. They won't understand.
say:18:1220912013:0.source_cn: 行了，别跟他们多说，他们吃得饱穿得暖，咱们的生活他们才...

say:19:1220912014:0.text: You think we like stealing? Thing is, if we don't, we'll never afford medicine... The others won't last much longer!
say:19:1220912014:0.source_cn: 你当咱们愿意冒险偷东西啊，可要是不这样，咱们就连买药的...
say:19:1220912014:0.male: You think we like stealing? Thing is, if we don't, we'll never afford medicine... The others won't last much longer!
say:19:1220912014:0.female: You think we like stealing? Thing is, if we don't, we'll never afford medicine... The others won't last much longer!

say:21:1220912015:1.text: So that's how it is... Chippy was a bit too harsh earlier...
say:21:1220912015:1.source_cn: 居然是这样……唔，满满刚才是不是凶了一点……

say:23:1220912016:0.text: Why didn't you say this sooner? I'm a mage, skilled at making healing potions!
say:23:1220912016:0.source_cn: 呀，你怎么不早说！我可是魔法师，很擅长调配治疗药剂的！

say:24:1220912017:0.text: ...You mean... you're going to help us? You can treat the sick?
say:24:1220912017:0.source_cn: ……你是说……你们要帮咱？你们懂得看病？

choice_prompt:25:1220912017.text: ...You mean... you're going to help us? You can treat the sick?
choice_prompt:25:1220912017.source_cn: ……你是说……你们要帮咱？你们懂得看病？

say:26:1220912018:0.text: Truly? Please, help us! We're willing to take on any job to pay for the medicine!
say:26:1220912018:0.source_cn: 真的吗？求求你们帮帮忙！咱愿意干活来抵药费，干什么都行的！
say:26:1220912018:0.male: Truly? Please, help us! We're willing to take on any job to pay for the medicine!
say:26:1220912018:0.female: Truly? Please, help us! We're willing to take on any job to pay for the medicine!

say:27:1220912019:0.text: Of course we'll help you, but we need to mix the healing potion first. Tell us where to find you, and we'll come as soon as it's ready.
say:27:1220912019:0.source_cn: 别急呀，还要调配治疗药水的。你把地址告诉我们，等药水配...

say:28:1220912020:0.text: Thank you... We're currently living on the side of the road on White Shark Street, just over the bridge.
say:28:1220912020:0.source_cn: 谢谢……我们现在住在白鲨鱼街的路边，喏，就在桥那边。
say:28:1220912020:0.male: Thank you... We're currently living on the side of the road on White Shark Street, just over the bridge.
say:28:1220912020:0.female: Thank you... We're currently living on the side of the road on White Shark Street, just over the bridge.

say:31:1220912011:1.text: A few of the little ones came down with bad fevers, but we can't afford to pay a doctor!
say:31:1220912011:1.source_cn: 我们有几个小兄弟发了高烧，但我们的钱根本不够请医生看病！
say:31:1220912011:1.male: A few of the little ones came down with bad fevers, but we can't afford to pay a doctor!
say:31:1220912011:1.female: A few of the little ones came down with bad fevers, but we can't afford to pay a doctor!

say:32:1220912012:0.text: They're still young, too weak to handle the heavy rains and strong winds we've been having...
say:32:1220912012:0.source_cn: 他们年纪还小，身体太弱了，扛不住前几天的暴雨和大风……
say:32:1220912012:0.male: They're still young, too weak to handle the heavy rains and strong winds we've been having...
say:32:1220912012:0.female: They're still young, too weak to handle the heavy rains and strong winds we've been having...

say:0:1220913001:0.text: We need a few more ingredients for the potion, let's search outside the city.
say:0:1220913001:0.source_cn: 配药剂还缺几种材料，我们去城外找找吧。
say:0:1220913001:0.male: We need a few more ingredients for the potion, let's search outside the city.
say:0:1220913001:0.female: We need a few more ingredients for the potion, let's search outside the city.

say:1:1220913002:0.text: Hammie, will this potion cure them?
say:1:1220913002:0.source_cn: 漫漫，这种药能治好他们吗？

say:2:1220913003:0.text: This is a classic alchemical formula, it's foolproof!
say:2:1220913003:0.source_cn: 这可是经典的魔药配方，绝对没问题！

say:0:1220915001:0.text: These herbs should do it. Hammie, it's your turn to prepare the potion!
say:0:1220915001:0.source_cn: 这些药材应该够了。漫漫，轮到你炼制药剂啦！

say:0:1220916001:0.text: It's finished! Now let's go and find those children.
say:0:1220916001:0.source_cn: 调配完毕！咱们快去找那些孩子们吧。
say:0:1220916001:0.male: It's finished! Now let's go and find those children.
say:0:1220916001:0.female: It's finished! Now let's go and find those children.

say:0:1220920001:0.text: Thank you... gulp... ah, so bitter!
say:0:1220920001:0.male: Thank you... gulp... ah, so bitter!
say:0:1220920001:0.female: Thank you... gulp... ah, so bitter!

say:0:1220922001:0.text: Thank you, uh... do... do I have to drink all of it?
say:0:1220922001:0.source_cn: 谢谢，呃……这个……我都要喝掉吗？
say:0:1220922001:0.male: Thank you, uh... do... do I have to drink all of it?
say:0:1220922001:0.female: Thank you, uh... do... do I have to drink all of it?

narration:0:1220923001:0.text: The potion works its magic quickly, revitalizing the street children in no time at all.
narration:0:1220923001:0.source_cn: 药剂起效很快。没过多久，几个原本受着病痛折磨的流浪儿都...

say:4:1220923002:0.text: We're okay now! That bitter medicine was really strong!
say:4:1220923002:0.source_cn: 我们没事了！刚才那个苦苦的药好厉害！

say:5:1220923003:0.text: Feodor, is this the doctor you brought? The medicine must be so expensive. You must have spent a lot to help us...
say:5:1220923003:0.source_cn: 费曼大哥，这是你请来的医生吗？医药费一定很贵吧，为了给...

say:6:1220923004:0.text: Now that we're better, we can start earning money tomorrow—no, today! We'll help big brother Feodor!
say:6:1220923004:0.source_cn: 我们的病已经好了，明天、不，今天就能去搞钱的！我们都能...

say:10:1220923005:0.text: We don't want money, it's free treatment!
say:10:1220923005:0.source_cn: 你们这群小孩子……咳，我们不要钱，是免费治疗呦！

say:12:1220923007:0.text: So there are really good grown-ups in Rustport... Thank you, you're so kind!
say:12:1220923007:0.source_cn: 真的吗？原来锈锚港也有这样的好人啊……谢谢，你们真好！
say:12:1220923007:0.male: So there are really good grown-ups in Rustport... Thank you, you're so kind!
say:12:1220923007:0.female: So there are really good grown-ups in Rustport... Thank you, you're so kind!

say:13:1220923008:1.text: Ah, Chippy feels a bit embarrassed...

say:15:1220923009:1.text: Here's the money pouch back. I'm sorry... We used the money inside to buy medicine, and now there's just this little bit left.
say:15:1220923009:1.source_cn: 这个钱袋还给你，对不起……为了买药，咱用了里面的钱，现...
say:15:1220923009:1.male: Here's the money pouch back. I'm sorry... We used the money inside to buy medicine, and now there's just this little bit left.
say:15:1220923009:1.female: Here's the money pouch back. I'm sorry... We used the money inside to buy medicine, and now there's just this little bit left.

choice_prompt:16:1220923009.text: Here's the money pouch back. I'm sorry... We used the money inside to buy medicine, and now there's just this little bit left.
choice_prompt:16:1220923009.source_cn: 这个钱袋还给你，对不起……为了买药，咱用了里面的钱，现在只剩这么一点了。
choice_prompt:16:1220923009.male: Here's the money pouch back. I'm sorry... We used the money inside to buy medicine, and now there's just this little bit left.
choice_prompt:16:1220923009.female: Here's the money pouch back. I'm sorry... We used the money inside to buy medicine, and now there's just this little bit left.

say:17:1220923010:0.text: You... really don't want any other payment for the medicine?
say:17:1220923010:0.male: You... really don't want any other payment for the medicine?
say:17:1220923010:0.female: You... really don't want any other payment for the medicine?

say:18:1220923011:0.text: Chippy is a knight, and a knight never goes back on his word! But...
say:18:1220923011:0.source_cn: 满满可是个骑士，哪有骑士说话出尔反尔的呢！不过……

say:19:1220923013:0.text: Chippy thinks you should take the money pouch and apologize to the blind man in person.
say:19:1220923013:0.source_cn: 满满觉得，你该拿着钱袋，当面向盲人大叔道歉才对。

say:20:1220923014:0.text: Yes, you're right. We did wrong, and we should apologize...
say:20:1220923014:0.source_cn: 嗯，你说得对。咱做了错事，就应该去道歉……

say:21:1220923015:0.text: We'll go right away, no matter if we get scolded or have to find a way to repay him. We'll accept whatever comes.
say:21:1220923015:0.source_cn: 现在就去，不管是挨打挨骂还是要还钱，咱都认了。

say:24:1220923016:0.source_cn: 费曼大哥，我们跟你一起去！

say:25:1220923017:0.text: Don't underestimate me, kiddos. I'll go alone. You stay and rest, no running off!
say:25:1220923017:0.source_cn: 别小瞧你们费曼大哥，咱一个人去就行了。你们留下休息，不...

choice:16:0:1.text: It's alright, give it to me.
choice:16:0:1.male: It's alright, give it to me.
choice:16:0:1.female: It's alright, give it to me.

say:27:1220923012:0.text: Are you angry? This is really all the money left, but we'll find a way to pay back the blind man...
say:27:1220923012:0.source_cn: 你生气了吗？真的只有这点钱了，咱会想办法赚钱还给盲大叔的……

say:0:1220924001:0.text: Come, I'll take you to find the blind traveler.
say:0:1220924001:0.source_cn: 走吧，我带你去找那位盲人旅行者。
say:0:1220924001:0.male: Come, I'll take you to find the blind traveler.
say:0:1220924001:0.female: Come, I'll take you to find the blind traveler.

say:1:1220924002:0.text: Thanks... I hope he can forgive us street kids...
say:1:1220924002:0.source_cn: 谢谢……希望他能原谅咱这些流浪儿……
say:1:1220924002:0.male: Thanks... I hope he can forgive us street kids...
say:1:1220924002:0.female: Thanks... I hope he can forgive us street kids...

say:3:1220925001:0.text: Sir! Sir! We found your money pouch!
say:3:1220925001:0.source_cn: 大叔，大叔！你的钱袋找回来啦！

say:4:1220925002:1.source_cn: 什么？找到了！艾雅在上，你们可真厉害啊！

say:5:1220925003:0.source_cn: 窃贼难道真的是那些小孩子？

choice_prompt:6:1220925003.source_cn: 窃贼难道真的是那些小孩子？

say:7:1220925004:0.text: I see... Dura, please forgive those little ones...
say:7:1220925004:0.source_cn: 原来是这样……艾雅啊，原谅那些孩子们吧……
say:7:1220925004:0.male: I see... Dura, please forgive those little ones...
say:7:1220925004:0.female: I see... Dura, please forgive those little ones...

say:10:1220925005:0.text: Sir, I-I'm sorry... We really didn't know what else to do...
say:10:1220925005:0.source_cn: 大叔，对、对不起……咱当时实在是不知道该怎么办了。

say:11:1220925006:0.text: We promise to make back the spent money and return it to you.
say:11:1220925006:0.source_cn: 花掉的钱，咱一定能赚回来还给你。

say:12:1220925007:1.text: No, child. There's no need to repay me.
say:12:1220925007:1.source_cn: 不，孩子。这些钱不用再还给我了。

say:13:1220925008:0.text: Young one, listen. I love to travel, but now that I'm blind, it's very difficult for me.
say:13:1220925008:0.source_cn: 孩子，听我说。我喜欢到处旅行，但我现在看不见了，做什么...

say:14:1220925009:0.text: If you're willing, I'd like to hire you to guide me around Rustport, and that money shall be your payment. So, how about it?
say:14:1220925009:0.source_cn: 如果你愿意的话，我想雇你带我游览锈锚港。那些钱就是我付...

say:17:1220925011:0.text: Alright, sir, thank you for your kindness. And thank you all for helping us...
say:17:1220925011:0.source_cn: 好吧，大叔，谢谢你的善意，也谢谢你们的帮助……

say:18:1220925012:0.text: Leave the Rustport tour to us! All the others will help out!
say:18:1220925012:0.source_cn: 游览锈锚港的事，大叔就放心交给咱安排吧！咱所有的兄弟姐...

say:21:1220925013:0.text: Chippy loves a story with a happy ending!
say:21:1220925013:0.source_cn: 哈哈，故事有了圆满的结局，这才是满满最喜欢的！
say:21:1220925013:0.male: Chippy loves a story with a happy ending!
say:21:1220925013:0.female: Chippy loves a story with a happy ending!

choice:16:1:2.text: This would be a great job.
choice:16:1:2.male: This would be a great job.
choice:16:1:2.female: This would be a great job.

say:0:1220926001:0.text: Let's ask around here, someone must know!
say:0:1220926001:0.source_cn: 我们在附近找人问问吧，一定有人知道的！
say:0:1220926001:0.male: Let's ask around here, someone must know!
say:0:1220926001:0.female: Let's ask around here, someone must know!
